newsitem.title: CHINA: Daewoo to build, operate China highway.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to build, operate China highway.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Group has signed an agreement to build an expressway in eastern China and operate it for 30 years before transferring ownership to China, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

The 73.36-km (45.6-mile) expressway between Hangzhou, capital of the coastal province of Zhejiang, and Huangshan city in the central province of Anhui, would cost 1.6 billion yuan ($192.8 million), Xinhua said.
It was unclear which Daewoo company would undertake the project but the group includes Daewoo Corp among its numerous listed companies.
Daewoo would invest 960 million yuan with Huangshan providing the remaining 640 million yuan, it said.
The two parties would jointly operate the expressway for 30 years after which ownership would be transferred to Huangshan, Xinhua said.
Huangshan would give Daewoo preferential treatment to recover its investment, Xinhua said. It did not give further details.
